factory_facts._source: Published on clawclipfactory.com (home, capabilities, FAQ, custom-tooling, claw-clips pages), checked 2026-10-09. Only add facts the factory confirms.
factory_facts.core_process: Plastic injection molding. Injection molding, spring installation, assembly, inspection and packaging are handled in-house.
factory_facts.materials: ABS and PC for injection-molded clips; the final resin is selected per project. Model CL-001 is made in PP.
factory_facts.moq: Standard starting MOQ is 1,000 pieces per style; multi-style orders are evaluated style by style.
factory_facts.sample_lead_time: Typical sample target is about 7 days after requirements, sample fee and freight are confirmed; actual timing depends on mold readiness, material, color and sample scope.
factory_facts.sample_policy: The buyer pays the sample fee and freight; the sample fee can be credited against the production order when agreed.
factory_facts.quote_response: Quote requests are answered within 24 hours.
factory_facts.existing_molds: More than 10 existing mold styles; current availability is confirmed per inquiry.
factory_facts.customization: Custom solid or translucent resin colors; matte or polished surface options subject to material and design; color is matched to an agreed physical sample or color standard, not a screen value.
factory_facts.logo: Logo application is arranged through a specialized cooperating partner; method, MOQ and cost depend on the logo process and product design.
factory_facts.packaging_options: Packaging is done in-house; automatic packaging equipment is available for suitable formats; the format is confirmed per project.
factory_facts.quality_control: Molded parts are checked for visible defects, color consistency, filling, flash and deformation; molding conditions are locked after sample approval and kept for repeat batches.
factory_facts.new_tooling: A new shape, size or mechanical structure needs a feasibility review and a separate tooling quotation. Route: brief review, feasibility discussion, tooling quotation (scope, payment terms, timing and ownership conditions in writing), mold development, sample and revision, production release.
factory_facts.bulk_lead_time: TODO: typical bulk production range after sample approval (the site currently says it is confirmed per order)
factory_facts.payment_terms: Payment terms are agreed with each buyer during quotation.
factory_facts.products: CL-001 Soft Flexible Moon Cutout (105 mm, PP); CL-002 Rectangular Cutout Matte (105 mm, ABS); CL-003 Skeleton (110 mm, ABS, glossy); CL-004 Twist Cutout (110 mm, ABS). All from existing molds, supplied fully assembled, MOQ 1,000 pcs per style.
factory_facts.not_claimable: The factory is new to direct export and holds no third-party test reports or certifications yet. Never claim export history, countries shipped to, client numbers, certifications or test reports.
